exercises.question: Which sentence expresses a plan already in view? [¿Cuál expresa un plan ya previsto?]
options: Voy a preparar el itinerario esta noche. [I am going to prepare the itinerary tonight.]
Preparé el itinerario ayer. [I prepared the itinerary yesterday.]
Preparaba el itinerario cuando llegaste. [I was preparing the itinerary when you arrived.]

exercises.sentence: Mañana __ a salir temprano para evitar el tráfico. [Tomorrow we are going to leave early to avoid the traffic.] (ir)

exercises.english: We are going to buy the tickets tomorrow.

sentences: Primero vamos a preparar el itinerario. [First we are going to prepare the itinerary.]
Después compraremos los billetes. [Then we will buy the tickets.]
Finalmente prepararemos el equipaje. [Finally we will prepare the luggage.]

exercises.question: Which sentence is a prediction rather than an immediate plan? [¿Cuál es una predicción y no un plan inmediato?]
options: El viaje será largo. [The journey will be long.]
Voy a preparar el equipaje. [I am going to prepare the luggage.]
Vamos a comprar los billetes. [We are going to buy the tickets.]

exercises.sentence: El viaje __ largo, pero llegaremos antes de anochecer. [The journey will be long, but we will arrive before nightfall.] (ser)
Voy a preparar el itinerario esta noche.
options: I am going to prepare the itinerary tonight.
I prepared the itinerary yesterday.
I was preparing the itinerary when you arrived.

exercises.sentence: El viaje será largo, pero llegaremos antes de anochecer.
options: The journey will be long, but we will arrive before nightfall.
The journey was short, but we arrived yesterday.
We are going to cancel the journey tonight.

exercises.sentence: Mañana vamos a salir temprano para evitar el tráfico.
Si todo está preparado, compraremos los billetes mañana.
options: If everything is ready, we will buy the tickets tomorrow.
If everything was ready, we bought the tickets yesterday.
We are going to buy the tickets because the train was late.

prompt.speaker: A
prompt.text: ¿Qué vais a hacer antes de salir?

options: Vamos a preparar el equipaje y comprobar el itinerario. [We are going to prepare the luggage and check the itinerary.]
Preparamos el equipaje ayer. [We prepared the luggage yesterday.]
Preparábamos el equipaje cuando saldremos. [We were preparing the luggage when we will leave.]
Sí, llegaremos antes de las ocho. [Yes, we will arrive before eight.]
Sí, vamos a llegamos antes de las ocho. [Yes, we are to arrive before eight.]
Sí, llegábamos antes de las ocho mañana. [Yes, we used to arrive before eight tomorrow.]
Vamos a buscar un alojamiento cerca de la estación. [We are going to look for accommodation near the station.]
Buscamos un alojamiento ayer. [We looked for accommodation yesterday.]
Buscaremos un alojamiento cuando éramos jóvenes. [We would look for accommodation when we were young.]

template.prompt: State your travel plan using ir a + infinitive and include one new travel word.
template.answer: Voy a preparar el itinerario y a reservar el alojamiento.

template.prompt: Make one prediction about the journey using the future tense.
template.answer: El viaje será largo, pero llegaremos a tiempo.
